::: {.key-question}
What community, cultural, and systemic factors influence the ability of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people and families in the NEPHU catchment to thrive, exercise self-determination, and access culturally safe environments to support their health and wellbeing?
:::

## All Emergency Department Presentations

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ED presentations - all presentations
# Data from PHIDU Social Health Atlas
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in PHIDU data
emergency_total <- f_read_phidu_iare_hospital(data_sheet    = "ED_sex",
                                              column_select = "emergency_department_presentations_total_aboriginal_presentations")

# Data wrangling
emergency_total <- emergency_total %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(iare_name = factor(iare_name, levels = iare_inc_vic_lvl)) %>%
  #
  dplyr::arrange(iare_name)
```

- Data for this topic were obtained from the [Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Social Health Atlas of Australia](https://phidu.torrens.edu.au/social-health-atlases), compiled from the [AIHW National Non-Admitted Patient Emergency Department Care Database (NNAPEDCD)](https://www.aihw.gov.au/reports/hospitals/non-admitted-patient-emergency-dept-care-nmds/summary).

- Between 01 July 2022 and 30 June 2023 there were 19,955 emergency department presentations for Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people living in Greater Melbourne.

- The number of emergency department presentations for Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people living in different IAREs within the NEPHU catchment ranged from 2,715 (Northcote/Preston/Whittlesea IARE) to 308 (Whitehorse IARE).

- The age-standardised rate of emergency department presentations for Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people living in different IAREs within the NEPHU catchment ranged from 64,492 per 100,000 population (Melbourne/Port Phillip IARE) to 38,434 per 100,000 population (Melbourne East IARE).

- 6 of the 10 IAREs in the NEPHU catchment area had an age-standardised rate of emergency department presentations above the average rate for all Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people living in Greater Melbourne (Melbourne/Port Phillip, Moreland/Broadmeadows, Northcote/Preston/Whittlesea, Melbourne North-East, Whitehorse, and Craigieburn/Sunbury IAREs).

<div style="height: 0.1em;"></div>

- Data relating to emergency department presentations for specific conditions can be found in the relevant sections of this report:
  - [Arthritis and Musculoskeletal Conditions](10c_outcomes_arthritis.qmd)
  - [Circulatory System Diseases](10g_outcomes_cardiovascular.qmd)
  - [Respiratory System Diseases](10i_outcomes_respiratory.qmd)
  - [Infectious and Parasitic Diseases](10k_outcomes_infectious.qmd)
  - [Mental and Behavioural Disorders](10l_outcomes_mentalhealth.qmd)
  - [Injuries, Poisoning, and Selected Other External Causes of Morbidity and Mortality](10m_outcomes_injury.qmd)

#### `r figtab_figure_title`

::: {.fig-tab-title}
**`r figtab_figure_title`:** Number and age-standardised rate (per 100,000 population) of emergency department presentations for people who identified as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander, `r note_geography_nephu`, by `r note_comparison_iare`, `r note_time_emergency`
:::

```{r}
#
figure_number <- emergency_total %>% 
  f_bar_simple_iare(y_variable = aboriginal_n,
                    hospital   = "emergency")

figure_percent <- emergency_total %>% 
  f_bar_simple_iare(y_variable = aboriginal_rate,
                    hospital   = "emergency")

f_bar_simple_combine(figure_number, figure_percent)
```


```{r}
#
figtab_table_count  <- figtab_table_count + 1

```

#### `r figtab_table_title`

::: {.fig-tab-title}
**`r figtab_table_title`:** Emergency department presentations for people who identified as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander, `r note_geography_nephu`, by `r note_comparison_iare`, `r note_time_emergency`
:::

```{r}
#
table <- emergency_total %>%
  dplyr::select(-iare_name_short)

if (!file.exists(paste0(here::here(), "/data/", figtab_table_number, ".csv"))) {
  
  write.csv(table, paste0(here::here(), "/data/", figtab_table_number, ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  
}

table %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(aboriginal_rate = round(aboriginal_rate, digits = 0),
                hospital_ratio  = round(hospital_ratio, digits = 0)) %>% 
  #
  f_table_simple(iare     = "yes",
                 hospital = "emergency")
```

## Urgent Emergency Department Presentations

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ED presentations - urgent presentations
# Data from PHIDU Social Health Atlas
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in PHIDU data
emergency_urgent <- f_read_phidu_iare_hospital(data_sheet    = "ED_total_triage_category",
                                               column_select = "emergency_department_presentations_urgent_presentations_aboriginal_people")

# Data wrangling
emergency_urgent <- emergency_urgent %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(iare_name = factor(iare_name, levels = iare_inc_vic_lvl)) %>%
  #
  dplyr::arrange(iare_name)
```

- Data for this topic were obtained from the [Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Social Health Atlas of Australia](https://phidu.torrens.edu.au/social-health-atlases), compiled from the [AIHW National Non-Admitted Patient Emergency Department Care Database (NNAPEDCD)](https://www.aihw.gov.au/reports/hospitals/non-admitted-patient-emergency-dept-care-nmds/summary).

- Between 01 July 2022 and 30 June 2023 there were 9,030 urgent emergency department presentations for Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people living in Greater Melbourne.

- The number of urgent emergency department presentations for Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people living in different IAREs within the NEPHU catchment ranged from 1,179 (Northcote/Preston/Whittlesea IARE) to 121 (Whitehorse IARE).

- The age-standardised rate of urgent emergency department presentations for Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people living in different IAREs within the NEPHU catchment ranged from 29,774 per 100,000 population (Melbourne/Port Phillip IARE) to 17,045 per 100,000 population (Melbourne East IARE).

- 5 of the 10 IAREs in the NEPHU catchment area had an age-standardised rate of urgent emergency department presentations above the average rate for all Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people living in Greater Melbourne (Melbourne/Port Phillip, Moreland/Broadmeadows, Northcote/Preston/Whittlesea, Melbourne North-East, and Craigieburn/Sunbury IAREs).

::: {.callout-tip title="Definitions and notes about this topic" icon=false collapse=false}
- `r note_aboriginality_vemd`

<div style="height: 0.1em;"></div>

`r note_caveat_iare_ratio`

<div style="height: 0.1em;"></div>

- *Urgent emergency presentations* were defined as those with a triage category of urgent (requiring treatment within 30 minutes of arrival). 
:::
